description: This file defines the CompositeService class, which manages a collection of services, providing methods to initialize, start, stop, and handle shutdown hooks for these services within the Apache Hive project.

classes.name: CompositeService
classes.description: A service that manages a list of sub-services, providing lifecycle management methods.

classes.name: CompositeServiceShutdownHook
classes.description: A JVM shutdown hook class that gracefully stops the CompositeService during JVM shutdown.

methods.name: getServices
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable collection of managed services.

methods.name: addService
methods.description: Adds a service to the service list.

methods.name: removeService
methods.description: Removes a service from the service list.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes all managed services with the given HiveConf.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts all managed services in order.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all managed services in reverse order.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops a specified number of services in reverse order.
